{{Top|leg}}
The '''Shahlik family''' were [[Sedrian]]s who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kailor V]] and were responsible for the maintenance of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Aquarium/Legends|aquaria]] on the world. The [[sentientologist]] [[Obo Rin]] attempted to interview them for his entry on Sedrians in the ''[[Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy]]'' but they refused his request. Rin believed that they might not have been able to answer his questions or confirm information about their [[Species/Legends|species]] as they had been removed from [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] for several generations.
